title: A Confession for the Letter
author: Dominic Whitlock
blurb: Jude Nakamura, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
